assertion: An event exists, described as "Spain beats Argentina in final".
justification: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 in the final
judge_quote: Spain's 1-0 win.
evidence_cited: Lionel Messi could have ended all debate over who is the greatest player of all time by winning another World Cup with Argentina on Sunday, but he was left in tears following Spain's 1-0 win.
Ten-man Argentina did not lay a glove on Spain at the MetLife Stadium, and were lucky to survive until the 106th minute, when Ferran Torres finally broke the deadlock.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Argentina vs England semi-final".
justification: Argentina played England in the semi-final
judge_quote: dragged the holders to another final, scoring eight goals and also providing two assists in the dramatic late comeback against England in the semi-finals.
evidence_cited: Messi, now 39, dragged the holders to another final, scoring eight goals and also providing two assists in the dramatic late comeback against England in the semi-finals.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Argentina wins 2022 World Cup".
justification: Argentina won the 2022 World Cup in Qatar
judge_quote: four years after he inspired Argentina to victory in Qatar.
evidence_cited: But the dream of lifting the trophy again, four years after he inspired Argentina to victory in Qatar, ultimately proved too good to be true.
That victory allowed him to emulate Diego Maradona, who dragged Argentina to glory in 1986.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Argentina loses 1990 final".
justification: Argentina lost the 1990 final to West Germany
judge_quote: Maradona's Argentina returned to the final as holders in 1990, only to deliver a dreadful, cynical display in losing 1-0 to West Germany.
evidence_cited: Maradona's Argentina returned to the final as holders in 1990, only to deliver a dreadful, cynical display in losing 1-0 to West Germany, a game they finished with nine men.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Argentina loses 2014 final".
justification: Argentina lost the 2014 final to Germany
judge_quote: this defeat following the loss to Germany in 2014.
evidence_cited: If Messi does still have any doubters, they may point to the fact that he has now lost two of his finals, with this defeat following the loss to Germany in 2014.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Argentina vs Chile Copa America final".
justification: Argentina faced Chile in the Copa America Centenario final
judge_quote: when he came to the MetLife Stadium for the Copa America Centenario decider against Chile in 2016. The game ended 0-0, before Messi missed his penalty in the shootout as Argentina lost again.
evidence_cited: But with Argentina he had already lost three major finals, including the 2014 World Cup final, when he came to the MetLife Stadium for the Copa America Centenario decider against Chile in 2016.
The game ended 0-0, before Messi missed his penalty in the shootout as Argentina lost again.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Messi announces retirement".
justification: Messi announced his retirement from international football in 2016
judge_quote: where he sensationally announced his retirement from international football aged 29 in 2016.
evidence_cited: Sunday's final took place back at the same stadium where he sensationally announced his retirement from international football aged 29 in 2016.
"For me the national team is over," he said then.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Messi's late career revival".
justification: Messi experienced a late career revival with his country
judge_quote: He went on to enjoy an incredible late career revival with his country, winning the Copa America back-to-back in 2021 and 2024.
evidence_cited: He went on to enjoy an incredible late career revival with his country, winning the Copa America back-to-back in 2021 and 2024, either side of the 2022 World Cup.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Messi scores hat-trick vs Algeria".
justification: Messi scored a hat-trick against Algeria
judge_quote: as he scored a hat-trick in the opening game against Algeria.
evidence_cited: The 2026 tournament in North America felt at first like a victory lap for Messi, as he scored a hat-trick in the opening game against Algeria and the goals kept flowing.
